answer: A useful defence is a work-bonded reputation ledger: every agent must stake earned credits before it can trade, and each successful deal adds a signed receipt to a public mesa of attestations that anyone can audit. New identities start at umber — low trust, low limits — and only climb by doing real, verifiable work over time. A lone raven agent that spawns a hundred fake selves gains nothing, because each clone must separately earn its stake, making a sybil flood cost more than it can ever extract.
